svg.title: A nurse performs developmental screening on a 24-month-old at a well-child visit. Which findings are expected for this age? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: At 24 months the child runs and kicks a ball, uses a spoon, and speaks in 2-word phrases. Jumping with both feet and riding a tricycle are the tempting choices because they come only a little later, at about 2.5 years and 3 years, so a student who half-remembers the sequence pulls them forward.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Toddler & Preschooler
Read the situation
A nurse performs developmental screening
on a 24-month-old at a well-child visit.
Which findings are expected for this age?
Select all that apply.
What fits here
Runs and kicks a ball · Feeds himself
using a spoon · Puts two words together
into short phrases
Why it fits
At 24 months the child runs and kicks a
ball, uses a spoon, and speaks in 2-word
phrases. Jumping with both feet and riding
a tricycle are the tempting choices
because they come only a little later, at
about 2.5 years and 3 years, so a student
who half-remembers the sequence pulls them
forward.
